authority.authorization: Director agreed to a full-scene diagnostic with no new generation after Crop 04 earned crop-scale mechanism continuation.

deterministic_mapping.rationale: Preserve full generated width and minimize geometric loss while reconciling Adobe's 2:3 output with the fixed 258x383 Reference-17 crop registration.
deterministic_mapping.trim: 6 pixels from top and 6 pixels from bottom; no horizontal crop
deterministic_mapping.resampler: System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic with HighQuality pixel offset/compositing
deterministic_mapping.aspect_note: The 768x1140 intermediate differs from target aspect by ~0.008%; final resize is exact 258x383.
deterministic_mapping.mask_application: Copy Reference 17 unchanged, then replace RGB only at crop-local pixels where Boundary 01 equals 255; preserve original Reference-17 alpha at every pixel.

required_verification: Every decoded RGBA pixel outside Boundary 01 exactly equals Reference 17.
Outside-mask maximum absolute RGBA difference equals 0.
No new generation, mask widening, translation, feathering or production publication.
